title: 304 Stainless Steel Moka Pot Hand Brewed Coffee Pot High Pressure Cold Extraction Single Valve Coffee Equipment For Home Cafe
body_html: 1、Multi Functional Design: The mocha pot can be used to make coffee, hand brewed coffee, and cold extracted coffee, meeting the needs of different flavors. 2、Unique Single Valve Design: The moka pot adopts a single valve to control the water flow, ensuring uniform coffee extraction and delicate taste. 3、304 Stainless Steel Moka Coffee Pot: The moka coffee pot is made of 304 stainless steel, which is durable and easy to clean. 4、Italian Flavor: The moka coffee pot is concentrated under high pressure, presenting the rich taste of traditional Italian coffee. 5、Easy to Operate: The 304 stainless steel moka coffee pot is easy to operate and suitable for home use and coffee enthusiasts.Item Type: Moka Coffee PotMaterial: Stainless SteelWeight: Approx. 463g / 16.3oz1 x Moka Coffee Pot1 x English Instruction Manual
